# Notebook setup

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Only the packages used in this script are loaded.
# plyr is NOT loaded: attached after dplyr it masks summarise()/mutate() and ignores group_by().
# tidylog is loaded last so its dplyr wrappers are the active ones.
packages_used <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "scales",
                   "phyloseq", "microbiome", "vegan", "pairwiseAdonis",
                   "flextable", "officer", "beepr", "tidylog")

suppressMessages(invisible(
  lapply(packages_used, library, character.only = TRUE)
))

missing_pkgs <- setdiff(packages_used, .packages())
if (length(missing_pkgs) == 0) {
  message("All packages loaded correctly")
} else {
  message("Packages that did not load: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}
rm(packages_used, missing_pkgs)

# Plot theme and chunk options
theme_set(theme_minimal())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Same flextable defaults as in 3.morphotypes.Rmd
set_flextable_defaults(theme_fun = theme_vanilla, font.size = 10, bold_header = TRUE)

# Save numeric sequential copies of graphs in a path
auto_filename <- function(base, ext) {
  base <- sub(paste0("\\.", ext, "$"), "", base)  # remove extension if included
  full_path <- paste0(base, ".", ext)
  i <- 1
  while (file.exists(full_path)) {
    full_path <- paste0(base, "_", i, ".", ext)
    i <- i + 1
  }
  full_path
}

# Community matrix (samples as rows) from a phyloseq object, whatever its orientation
otu_matrix <- function(ps) {
  m <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) m <- t(m)
  m
}

# One definition of "unassigned" taxonomy, used by the heatmap and the core microbiome
is_unassigned <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | x == "" |
    grepl("unknown|unidentified|uncultured|unclassified|metagenome", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

message(paste0(utf8::as_utf8("\U0001f600"), " All good!"))
beep(2)
```

# Introduction

First we filter and normalize the data, then we make exploratory heatmaps and barplots of the communities at different taxonomic levels.

The stacked (long) TSS dataframe is used for proportions, barplots and the heatmap. The TSS phyloseq object is used for the core microbiome and the community matrix.

# Data upload 

Starting from the TSS stacked dataframe and the TSS phyloseq object.

```{r stacked dataframes, echo=FALSE}
taxa_stacked <- read.csv("data/ASV_taxa_stacked_tss.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(ASV = OTU) %>% 
  select(-any_of(c("X", "X.1", "X.2"))) %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Unassigned", Phylum))

# TSS phyloseq object (same file as in 3.morphotypes.Rmd)
phylo <- readRDS("data/bcms_filtered&tss_reefs_raja2023.rds")

# Number of samples per site (used to average per site)
sample_n_site <- taxa_stacked %>%
  distinct(site, sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::count(site, name = "n_samples")

# ---- Checks ----
# 1. Each sample should sum to 1 (TSS)
summary(taxa_stacked %>%
          group_by(sample_id) %>%
          summarise(total = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          pull(total))

# 2. Every sample should have the same number of rows (zeros kept)
if (n_distinct(dplyr::count(taxa_stacked, sample_id)$n) > 1)
  message("Samples have different numbers of rows: zeros may have been dropped from the stacked file")

# 3. Stacked file and phyloseq object should contain the same samples
setdiff(unique(taxa_stacked$sample_id), sample_names(phylo))
setdiff(sample_names(phylo), unique(taxa_stacked$sample_id))
```

```{r}
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage))
phylum_totals
```

By Genus

```{r}
  group_by(Phylum, Genus) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%

genus_totals
```

## Top 10 Phyla barplot

Prepare dataframe
```{r}
# Top 10 most abundant phyla overall (phylum_totals is already sorted)
top10_phyla <- head(phylum_totals$Phylum, 10)

# Collapse other phyla into "Other Phyla"
taxa_stacked_mod <- taxa_stacked %>%
  mutate(Phylum = ifelse(Phylum %in% top10_phyla, Phylum, "Other Phyla"))

# Percentage per site (pooled within site = mean across samples, since each sample sums to 1)
phylum_percentages <- taxa_stacked_mod %>%
  group_by(site_type, site, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Stacking order: preferred order first, any other top-10 phylum next,
# then Unassigned and Other Phyla (no phylum silently turns into NA)
phylum_order_pref <- c("Cyanobacteriota", "Proteobacteria", "Bacteroidota", "Planctomycetota",
                       "Crenarchaeota", "Verrucomicrobiota", "Actinobacteriota", "Acidobacteriota",
                       "Fusobacteriota", "Desulfobacterota", "Myxococcota")
phylum_order <- c(intersect(phylum_order_pref, top10_phyla),
                  setdiff(top10_phyla, c(phylum_order_pref, "Unassigned")),
                  intersect("Unassigned", top10_phyla),
                  "Other Phyla")

missing_cols <- setdiff(phylum_order, names(all_colors))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) message("Phyla without a colour: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

phylum_percentages <- phylum_percentages %>%
  mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = phylum_order),
         site   = factor(site, levels = order_sitetype))
```

Summary
```{r}
dominant_phyla <- c("Cyanobacteriota", "Proteobacteria", "Bacteroidota", "Planctomycetota")

# 1. Overall percentage per phylum (all samples together)
overall <- phylum_percentages %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(total / sum(total) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage))
overall

# Combined % of the four dominant phyla
overall %>% filter(Phylum %in% dominant_phyla) %>% summarise(combined = sum(percentage))

# 2. Range across sites (min and max, with site names)
site_ranges <- phylum_percentages %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% dominant_phyla) %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    min_pct  = round(min(percentage), 2),
    min_site = site[which.min(percentage)],
    max_pct  = round(max(percentage), 2),
    max_site = site[which.max(percentage)],
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
site_ranges

# 3. Percentage per site type
by_type <- phylum_percentages %>%
  group_by(site_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_abundance), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(total / sum(total) * 100, 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% dominant_phyla) %>%
  select(-total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site_type, values_from = percentage)
by_type

# 4. Wide table of site percentages (supplementary table)
site_table <- phylum_percentages %>%
  select(site, Phylum, percentage) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(percentage, 2)) %>%
  arrange(site) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = percentage, values_fill = 0)
site_table
```


Plot
```{r}
phyla_stack_plot <- 
  ggplot(phylum_percentages, aes(x = site, y = percentage, fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 most abundant phyla by site",
       x = "Site",
       y = "Relative Abundance (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ site_type, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(site_type = facet_labels_sitetype))
```


##Top 50 Genus

For results and supplements descriptions
```{r}
topN_genus <- 50

# Top 50 most abundant genera overall (genus_totals is already sorted)
top_genus <- unique(head(genus_totals$Genus, topN_genus))

# Collapse other genera into "Other genus" (with one shared phylum label, so it is not split across phyla)
Genus_percentages <- taxa_stacked %>%
  mutate(Genus  = ifelse(Genus %in% top_genus, Genus, "Other genus"),
         Phylum = ifelse(Genus == "Other genus", "Mixed", Phylum)) %>%
  group_by(site_type, site, Phylum, Genus) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * total_abundance / sum(total_abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Consistency check: no genus can exceed its own phylum at a site. Should return 0 rows.
phylum_site_full <- taxa_stacked %>%
  group_by(site, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(phylum_pct = 100 * total / sum(total)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-total)

Genus_percentages %>%
  filter(Genus != "Other genus") %>%
  left_join(phylum_site_full, by = c("site", "Phylum")) %>%
  filter(percentage > phylum_pct + 1e-6)
```

# Heatmap Community

Adjust the taxonomic value and the topN. TopN = Top most abundant of a defined range and taxonomic level.

```{r Top 50}
fill_level <- "Phylum"   # level used for the colour sidebar
taxa_level <- "Genus"    # level shown as heatmap rows
topN       <- 50
all        <- FALSE      # TRUE = plot every taxon instead of the top N
```

## Temporary df

```{r temporary dataframe}
# Site means = sum of relative abundance / number of samples in the site.

toplot <- taxa_stacked %>%
  dplyr::rename(fill = all_of(fill_level), taxa = all_of(taxa_level)) %>%
  mutate(
    unident = is_unassigned(taxa),
    taxa    = ifelse(unident, "Unidentified", taxa),
    fill    = ifelse(unident, paste("Unidentified", taxa_level), fill)
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, site_type, taxa, fill) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sample_n_site, by = "site") %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = total / n_samples) %>%
  select(-total, -n_samples) %>%
  # add explicit zeros so absent taxa get an "Absent" tile
  complete(nesting(taxa, fill), nesting(site, site_type),
           fill = list(relative_abundance = 0))

# Select the top N taxa by mean abundance across sites
if (all) topN <- n_distinct(toplot$taxa)

selected <- toplot %>%
  group_by(taxa) %>%
  summarise(meanAbun = mean(relative_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(meanAbun, n = topN, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(taxa)

toplot <- toplot %>% filter(taxa %in% selected)
```

## Heatmap plot

Heatmap of the top 50 most abundant

```{r}
# Abundance classes: lower limits as proportions, labels in %
abund_breaks <- c(0, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.10, Inf)
abund_labels <- c("<0.25", "0.25\u20130.5", "0.5\u20131", "1\u20132.5", "2.5\u201310", ">10")

abund_colors <- c(
  "Absent"          = "#FFFFFF",
  "<0.25"           = "#F2F2F2",
  "0.25\u20130.5"   = "#D1D1D1",
  "0.5\u20131"      = "#ADADAD",
  "1\u20132.5"      = "#878787",
  "2.5\u201310"     = "#585858",
  ">10"             = "#262626"
)

dark_classes <- c("2.5\u201310", ">10")  # these get white labels

# Prepare data

heatmap_data <- toplot   # already one value per site and taxon

# Phylum order: by total abundance, Unidentified always last
heatmap_phylum_order <- heatmap_data %>%
  group_by(fill) %>%
  summarise(totalAbun = sum(relative_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-totalAbun) %>%
  pull(fill)

heatmap_phylum_order <- c(
  heatmap_phylum_order[!grepl("Unidentified", heatmap_phylum_order)],
  heatmap_phylum_order[grepl("Unidentified", heatmap_phylum_order)]
)

# Genus order: grouped by phylum, highest to lowest within phylum.
# Reversed because ggplot draws y levels bottom-to-top.
taxa_order <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(fill = factor(fill, levels = heatmap_phylum_order)) %>%
  group_by(fill, taxa) %>%
  summarise(meanAbun = mean(relative_abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(fill, -meanAbun) %>%
  pull(taxa) %>%
  unique() %>%
  rev()

# True zeros get their own "Absent" class; labels use 1 decimal, "<0.1" for tiny values, "–" for absent
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    fill  = factor(fill, levels = heatmap_phylum_order),
    taxa  = factor(taxa, levels = taxa_order),
    site  = factor(site, levels = order_sitetype),
    abund_class = as.character(cut(relative_abundance, breaks = abund_breaks,
                                   labels = abund_labels, right = FALSE)),
    abund_class = ifelse(relative_abundance == 0, "Absent", abund_class),
    abund_class = factor(abund_class, levels = names(abund_colors)),
    cell_label  = case_when(
      relative_abundance == 0    ~ "\u2013",
      relative_abundance < 0.001 ~ "<0.1",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(relative_abundance * 100, 1))
    )
  )


# Checks

missing_phyla <- setdiff(levels(heatmap_data$fill), names(phylum_colors))
if (length(missing_phyla) > 0)
  message("Phyla missing from palette: ", paste(missing_phyla, collapse = ", "))

if (any(is.na(heatmap_data$site)))
  message("Sites not in order_sitetype: ",
          paste(setdiff(unique(toplot$site), order_sitetype), collapse = ", "))


# 1. Phylum sidebar

phylum_anno <- heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(taxa, fill) %>%
  mutate(x = 1)

p_phylum <- ggplot(phylum_anno, aes(x = x, y = taxa, fill = fill)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors, name = "Phylum") +
  labs(y = "Phylum") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = 0.5))


# 2. Abundance heatmap

p_abund <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = site, y = taxa, fill = abund_class)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label, colour = abund_class %in% dark_classes),
            size = 4.25) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = abund_colors,
    drop   = FALSE,
    name   = "Relative\nAbundance (%)",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      reverse      = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(colour = "grey", linewidth = 0.3)
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Sampling Sites", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                     colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold.italic", size = 11,
                                     hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.75),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )


# 3. Combine

asv_heatmap <- p_phylum + p_abund +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.25, 12), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key = element_blank())

print(asv_heatmap)
```

# Core Microbiome

## Core ASVs

```{r core-members}
# Core: ASVs with abundance > 0 in more than 90% of samples
# (include.lowest = FALSE makes both cut-offs strict)
core_reef <- core_members(phylo, detection = 0,
                          prevalence = 0.90, include.lowest = FALSE)

length(core_reef)   # number of core ASVs
nsamples(phylo)     # number of samples
```

## Abundance and prevalence of the core ASVs

```{r core-data}
# Taxonomy with an ASV column (is_unassigned() is defined in the setup chunk)
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(phylo), "matrix")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  select(ASV, Phylum, Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum      = ifelse(is_unassigned(Phylum), "Unknown", Phylum),
    genus_known = !is_unassigned(Genus)
  )

# Abundance matrix: samples as rows, core ASVs as columns
abund <- otu_matrix(phylo)[, core_reef, drop = FALSE]

# Overall summary per core ASV
core_summary <- tibble(
  ASV        = colnames(abund),
  Prevalence = colMeans(abund > 0),
  MeanAbund  = colMeans(abund)
) %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV")

# Phyla ordered by number of core ASVs, Unknown last
# (own name, so the barplot's phylum_order is not overwritten)
core_phylum_order <- core_summary %>% dplyr::count(Phylum, sort = TRUE) %>% pull(Phylum)
core_phylum_order <- c(setdiff(core_phylum_order, "Unknown"), intersect(core_phylum_order, "Unknown"))

# Labels: genus name if assigned (numbered if a genus has several core ASVs), otherwise the ASV ID
core_summary <- core_summary %>%
  mutate(Phylum = factor(Phylum, levels = core_phylum_order)) %>%
  arrange(Phylum, desc(MeanAbund)) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    !genus_known ~ ASV,
    n() > 1      ~ paste(Genus, row_number()),
    TRUE         ~ Genus
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

core_summary
```

Save core summary in table

```{r}
# Read share from unrounded values
core_share <- round(sum(core_summary$MeanAbund) * 100, 1)

core_table <- core_summary %>% 
  select(-genus_known, -label) %>% 
  relocate(Phylum, Genus, ASV) %>% 
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), "Unassigned", Genus),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

core_flex <- flextable(core_table) %>%
  italic(i = ~ Genus != "Unassigned", j = "Genus") %>%   # genus names in italics
  merge_v(j = "Phylum") %>%                               # one phylum label per block
  valign(j = "Phylum", valign = "top") %>%
  add_footer_lines(paste0(
    "Core ASVs present in more than 90% of samples (n = ", nsamples(phylo), "). ",
    "Together they account for ", core_share, "% of the reads.")) %>%
  autofit()
core_flex

save_as_docx("Core microbiome ASVs" = core_flex,
             path = "outputs/stats/core_microbiome_asvs.docx")
write.csv(core_table, "outputs/stats/core_microbiome_asvs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


## Prevalence across detection thresholds

```{r core-thresholds, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 9}
# Abundance matrix: ASVs as rows, samples as columns
abund_mat <- t(otu_matrix(phylo))

# ">0" and "0.01%" gave identical results, so 0.01% is left out
detections <- c(0, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02)   # proportions
det_labels <- c(">0", "0.05", "0.1", "0.5", "1", "2")   # in %

# Prevalence of each core ASV at each detection threshold
core_thresh <- expand_grid(ASV = core_reef, Detection = detections) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Prevalence = mean(abund_mat[ASV, ] > Detection)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(core_summary, ASV, label, genus_known, Phylum), by = "ASV")

# Robustness score: mean prevalence across all thresholds
robustness <- core_thresh %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(Prevalence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(score)   # lowest first, so the most robust ends up on top

core_thresh <- core_thresh %>%
  mutate(
    label     = factor(label, levels = robustness$label),
    Detection = factor(Detection, levels = detections, labels = det_labels)
  )

# Genus names in italics, ASV IDs in plain text
italic_genera <- core_summary %>% filter(genus_known) %>% pull(label)
label_fun <- function(x) {
  parse(text = ifelse(x %in% italic_genera,
                      paste0("italic('", x, "')"),
                      paste0("'", x, "'")))
}

core_thresh.plot <- ggplot(core_thresh, aes(x = Detection, y = label, fill = Prevalence)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Prevalence * 100), colour = Prevalence > 0.6), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7F7F7", high = "#252525",
                      limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent,
                      name = "Prevalence") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_fun) +
  facet_grid(Phylum ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Detection threshold (% relative abundance)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )

core_thresh.plot
```

## Hill numbers

Package "MiscMetabar"

Hill numbers are the number of equiprobable species giving the same diversity value as the observed distribution.

-   Hill number 0: Species richness
-   Hill number 1: Exponential of Shannon Index
-   Hill number 2: Inverse of Simpson Index

```{r}
bray_dist <- vegdist(community.matx, method = "bray")
```

```{r}
pcoa_result <- cmdscale(bray_dist, eig = TRUE, k = 2)
```

## DF PCoA

```{r}
pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = rownames(community.matx),
  Axis1     = pcoa_result$points[, 1],
  Axis2     = -pcoa_result$points[, 2],   # axis flipped for display

)

# % variance explained
```

#dbRDA


Same five predictors as dbRDA all, dbRDA lakes and the partial models below (salinity was missing from this model but was used in the partial models and mentioned in the text).

```{r}
dbrda_reef <- capscale(community.matx.reef ~ temp.scaled + sal.scaled + chla.scaled + PO4.scaled + DIN.scaled,
                       data = env.reef, distance = "bray")
RsquareAdj(dbrda_reef)
summary(dbrda_reef)
```

##Anova

ANOVA test sequential (Type I): results depend on the order of the predictors in the formula. Use by = "margin" to test each predictor after all others.

```{r}
anova(dbrda_reef, permutations = 999)              # overall
anova(dbrda_reef, permutations = 999, by = "axis")  # per axis
anova(dbrda_reef, permutations = 999, by = "terms") # per predictor

plot(dbrda_reef)
```

In reefs: PO4, DIN, and Temp significantly explain the variation. Chl-a and salinity don't (check after rerunning with salinity in the model).

## Save tables

```{r}
# Builds the R2, inertia and ANOVA tables for a dbRDA and saves them as docx
dbrda_tables <- function(model, path) {
  rsq <- RsquareAdj(model)
  rsq_tbl <- data.frame(Metric = c("R2", "Adj_R2"),
                        Value  = c(rsq$r.squared, rsq$adj.r.squared))

  s <- summary(model)
  part_tbl <- data.frame(
    Metric     = c("Total", "Constrained", "Unconstrained"),
    Inertia    = c(s$tot.chi, s$constr.chi, s$unconst.chi),
    Proportion = c(s$tot.chi, s$constr.chi, s$unconst.chi) / s$tot.chi
  )

  anova_tbl <- data.frame(anova(model, by = "terms", permutations = 999)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Variable")

  save_as_docx("R2"                      = flextable(rsq_tbl),
               "Partitioning of Inertia" = flextable(part_tbl),
               "ANOVA by Terms"          = flextable(anova_tbl),
               path = path)

  list(R2 = rsq_tbl, Partition = part_tbl, Anova_by_terms = anova_tbl)
}

# Own name per model, so the lake tables don't overwrite the reef tables
final_tbl_reef <- dbrda_tables(dbrda_reef, "outputs/stats/dbrda_reefs_anova_r2_inertia.docx")
final_tbl_reef
```

## Partial dbRDA

```{r}
# Each predictor conditioned on the other four
dbrda_temp_reef <- capscale(community.matx.reef ~ temp.scaled + Condition(PO4.scaled + DIN.scaled + chla.scaled + sal.scaled),
                            data = env.reef, distance = "bray")
RsquareAdj(dbrda_temp_reef)
anova(dbrda_temp_reef)

dbrda_din_reef <- capscale(community.matx.reef ~ DIN.scaled + Condition(PO4.scaled + temp.scaled + chla.scaled + sal.scaled),
                           data = env.reef, distance = "bray")
RsquareAdj(dbrda_din_reef)
anova(dbrda_din_reef)

dbrda_po4_reef <- capscale(community.matx.reef ~ PO4.scaled + Condition(temp.scaled + DIN.scaled + chla.scaled + sal.scaled),
                           data = env.reef, distance = "bray")
RsquareAdj(dbrda_po4_reef)
anova(dbrda_po4_reef)
```

## Df for plot

```{r}
dbrda_scores.reef <- scores(dbrda_reef, display = "sites") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id")

dbrda_biplot.reef <- scores(dbrda_reef, display = "bp") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

dbrda_scoresdf.reef <- dbrda_scores.reef %>%
  left_join(env.reef %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")

# Significance from the reef ANOVA by terms
vectorsig.reef <- dbrda_biplot.reef %>%
  left_join(final_tbl_reef$Anova_by_terms %>%
              mutate(significant = Pr..F. < 0.05) %>%
              select(Variable, significant),
            by = c("variable" = "Variable"))
```

```{r}
       y = paste0("dbRDA CAP2 (", round(dbrda_reef$CCA$eig[2] / sum(dbrda_reef$CCA$eig) * 100, 1), "%)")) +
```
